In summary, our research is concerned with
a systematic analysis of the nonleptonic decays of B mesons.
the factorization of B decaying to two mesons in soft-collineral effective theory, which is a new method to study the factorization of nonleptonic weak decays.
the factorization of the amplitudes of B decays to two light mesons into the products of the matrix elements of the four-quark operators and the spectator interactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the factorization of the amplitudes of B decays is established to all orders in the strong coupling constant alpha_s at the level of the effective theory.
the amplitudess for B -> pi pi and B -> K pi at leading order in alpha_s and to all orders of alpha_s are factorized.
the factorization theorem for B decays to two light hadrons is established at leading order in alpha_s.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the factorization is achieved for B -> M M' with M and M' both being light mesons, where the factorization is defined as the separation between the hard and soft interactions.
the leading-order amplitudes for the B decays are factorized to the products of the current matrix elements in SCET and all orders in alpha_S.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the factorization is not spoiled by gluons that can be exchanged between the two sectors.
the factorization of the B decays is not spoiled by the spectator interactions at leading order in the SCET.
